title: Omukwano Eyakyuka
intro: Ogenda okubikkula emboozi y’omwoyo ogwabeera mu kisiikirize ky’obunnabbi naye ne gulonda ekkubo eryatuusa mu kuzikirizibwa. Omuntu ono yagabana amaka n’omu ku babaka Allah be yalonda kyokka n’alemererwa okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza. Ono munne eyabula y’ani?
clues: Nabeeranga mu bantu abaagaana okuyitibwa mu butuukirivu, era saabawakanya.
Nafumbirwa nabbi wa Allah, naye nga sigabana nzikiriza eyo.
Ababaka bwe bajja mu maka gange n’okulabula, saabakkiriza.
Munnange yalagirwa okuva mu kibuga n’abakkiriza, era nange saali mu bo.
Ekibonerezo kyakka ku bantu bange, era nazikirizibwa wamu nabo.
Nze njogerwako mu Quran nga ekyokulabirako ky’obutakkiriza, ku mabbali ga mukyala wa Nuh, mu Surah At-Tahrim.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
